+ # App Frontend Development Standards
+ 
+ ## Component Architecture
+ 
+ ### Component Structure
+ 
+ - **Use React.forwardRef** for components that need ref forwarding
+ - **Export both component and types** from each file
+ - **Use named exports** instead of default exports
+ - **Include displayName** for all forwardRef components
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Proper component structure
+ const MyComponent = React.forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MyComponentProps>(
+   ({className, children, ...props}, ref) => {
+     return (
+       <div ref={ref} className={cn('base-styles', className)} {...props}>
+         {children}
+       </div>
+     )
+   }
+ )
+ 
+ MyComponent.displayName = 'MyComponent'
+ 
+ export {MyComponent}
+ export type {MyComponentProps}
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Component Organization
+ 
+ - **Group related components** in feature directories
+ - **Use index.ts files** for clean exports
+ - **Separate types** into dedicated `types.ts` files
+ - **Co-locate stories** with components for Storybook
+ 
+ ### File Naming Conventions
+ 
+ - **PascalCase** for component files: `PersonnelFileCard.tsx`
+ - **camelCase** for utility files: `useDocumentData.ts`
+ - **kebab-case** for directories: `case-file-ui/`
+ - **Stories files** follow component name: `PersonnelFileCard.stories.tsx`
+ 
+ ## TypeScript Patterns
+ 
+ ### Type Definitions
+ 
+ - **Use discriminated unions** for complex data types
+ - **Extend base interfaces** for specialized components
+ - **Export all types** from index files
+ - **Use strict typing** for all props and state
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Proper type definitions
+ export type ClassificationLevel = 
+   | "unclassified"
+   | "confidential" 
+   | "secret"
+   | "top-secret"
+ 
+ export interface BaseDocumentData {
+   id: string
+   title: string
+   classification: ClassificationLevel
+   date: string
+   location?: string
+ }
+ 
+ export interface PersonnelFile extends BaseDocumentData {
+   type: "personnel"
+   name: string
+   rank?: string
+   // ... additional fields
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Props Interface Patterns
+ 
+ - **Extend HTML element props** when appropriate
+ - **Use optional props** for non-required fields
+ - **Include className prop** for styling flexibility
+ - **Use proper TypeScript generics** for reusable components
+ 
+ ## Styling Patterns
+ 
+ ### CSS Class Management
+ 
+ - **Use `cn()` utility** for conditional class merging
+ - **Follow Tailwind CSS** patterns and conventions
+ - **Use CSS custom properties** for theme values
+ - **Implement responsive design** with Tailwind breakpoints
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Proper class management
+ import {cn} from '@/utils'
+ 
+ const MyComponent = ({className, variant, ...props}) => {
+   return (
+     <div 
+       className={cn(
+         'base-styles',
+         variant === 'primary' && 'primary-styles',
+         variant === 'secondary' && 'secondary-styles',
+         className
+       )}
+       {...props}
+     />
+   )
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Design System Integration
+ 
+ - **Use consistent spacing** with Tailwind scale
+ - **Follow color palette** defined in globals.css
+ - **Implement dark mode** with CSS custom properties
+ - **Use consistent typography** with defined font families
+ 
+ ### Vintage Document Styling
+ 
+ - **Use paper texture backgrounds** for document components
+ - **Implement aged effects** with CSS gradients and shadows
+ - **Add subtle animations** for hover states
+ - **Maintain accessibility** with proper contrast ratios
+ 
+ ## Component Composition
+ 
+ ### Compound Component Pattern
+ 
+ - **Break complex components** into smaller, focused pieces
+ - **Use composition over inheritance** for flexibility
+ - **Maintain clear separation** of concerns
+ - **Export sub-components** for reusability
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Compound component pattern
+ const DocumentCard = ({children, ...props}) => (
+   <div className="document-card" {...props}>
+     {children}
+   </div>
+ )
+ 
+ const DocumentHeader = ({title, date}) => (
+   <div className="document-header">
+     <h1>{title}</h1>
+     <p>{date}</p>
+   </div>
+ )
+ 
+ const DocumentContent = ({children}) => (
+   <div className="document-content">
+     {children}
+   </div>
+ )
+ 
+ DocumentCard.Header = DocumentHeader
+ DocumentCard.Content = DocumentContent
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Props Spreading and Composition
+ 
+ - **Use `...props`** to forward HTML attributes
+ - **Maintain component flexibility** with className prop
+ - **Avoid prop drilling** with proper component structure
+ - **Use React.Children** for flexible content rendering
+ 
+ ## State Management
+ 
+ ### Local State Patterns
+ 
+ - **Use React.useState** for simple local state
+ - **Use React.useCallback** for event handlers
+ - **Use React.useMemo** for expensive computations
+ - **Avoid unnecessary re-renders** with proper dependencies
+ 
+ ### Context Usage
+ 
+ - **Create focused contexts** for specific features
+ - **Use context providers** at appropriate levels
+ - **Implement proper error boundaries** for context consumers
+ - **Document context usage** in component documentation
+ 
+ ## Performance Optimization
+ 
+ ### Rendering Optimization
+ 
+ - **Use React.memo** for expensive components
+ - **Implement proper key props** for list rendering
+ - **Avoid inline object creation** in render methods
+ - **Use lazy loading** for large components
+ 
+ ### Bundle Optimization
+ 
+ - **Use dynamic imports** for code splitting
+ - **Implement proper tree shaking** with named exports
+ - **Optimize images** with Next.js Image component
+ - **Minimize bundle size** with proper dependency management
+ 
+ ## Accessibility Standards
+ 
+ ### ARIA Implementation
+ 
+ - **Use semantic HTML** elements when possible
+ - **Add proper ARIA labels** for interactive elements
+ - **Implement keyboard navigation** for all interactive components
+ - **Ensure proper focus management** for modals and dialogs
+ 
+ ### Screen Reader Support
+ 
+ - **Provide descriptive alt text** for images
+ - **Use proper heading hierarchy** (h1, h2, h3, etc.)
+ - **Implement skip links** for navigation
+ - **Test with screen readers** regularly
+ 
+ ## Testing Patterns
+ 
+ ### Component Testing
+ 
+ - **Write unit tests** for all components
+ - **Test user interactions** with React Testing Library
+ - **Mock external dependencies** appropriately
+ - **Test accessibility** with jest-axe
+ 
+ ### Storybook Integration
+ 
+ - **Create comprehensive stories** for all components
+ - **Document component usage** with JSDoc comments
+ - **Test different states** and variants
+ - **Include accessibility testing** in stories
+ 
+ ## Error Handling
+ 
+ ### Error Boundaries
+ 
+ - **Implement error boundaries** at appropriate levels
+ - **Provide meaningful error messages** to users
+ - **Log errors** for debugging purposes
+ - **Gracefully handle** component failures
+ 
+ ### Form Validation
+ 
+ - **Validate user input** on both client and server
+ - **Provide clear error messages** for validation failures
+ - **Use proper form libraries** (React Hook Form, Formik)
+ - **Implement proper error states** in UI components
+ 
+ ## Documentation Standards
+ 
+ ### Code Documentation
+ 
+ - **Use JSDoc comments** for complex functions
+ - **Document component props** with TypeScript interfaces
+ - **Include usage examples** in component documentation
+ - **Maintain README files** for complex features
+ 
+ ### Component Documentation
+ 
+ - **Create Storybook stories** for all components
+ - **Document component variants** and use cases
+ - **Include accessibility information** in documentation
+ - **Provide code examples** for common usage patterns
+ 
+ ## File Structure Guidelines
+ 
+ ### Directory Organization
+ 
+ ```
+ src/
+ ├── components/
+ │   ├── documents/           # Document-related components
+ │   ├── ui/                  # Reusable UI components
+ │   ├── animations/          # Animation components
+ │   └── [feature]/           # Feature-specific components
+ ├── hooks/                   # Custom React hooks
+ ├── utils/                   # Utility functions
+ ├── types/                   # Global type definitions
+ └── styles/                  # Global styles
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Import/Export Patterns
+ 
+ - **Use absolute imports** with `@/` alias
+ - **Export from index files** for clean imports
+ - **Group related exports** logically
+ - **Use barrel exports** for feature directories
+ 
+ ## Best Practices Summary
+ 
+ ### ✅ DO
+ 
+ - Use TypeScript for all components
+ - Implement proper error boundaries
+ - Follow accessibility guidelines
+ - Use consistent naming conventions
+ - Write comprehensive tests
+ - Document component usage
+ - Optimize for performance
+ - Use proper state management
+ 
+ ### ❌ DON'T

+ - Use any type unnecessarily
+ - Skip accessibility implementation

+ - Ignore performance considerations
+ - Skip error handling

+ - Forget to test components
+ - Skip documentation
+

+ # Documents UI Design System
+ 
+ ## Vintage Document Design Philosophy
+ 
+ ### Design Principles
+ 
+ - **Authentic vintage aesthetics** with modern accessibility
+ - **Paper-based visual metaphors** for document hierarchy
+ - **Subtle aging effects** that enhance readability
+ - **Consistent classification system** for document types
+ - **Responsive design** that maintains vintage feel
+ 
+ ### Visual Hierarchy
+ 
+ - **Classification badges** as primary visual indicators
+ - **Typography hierarchy** using vintage font families
+ - **Paper texture backgrounds** for depth and authenticity
+ - **Subtle shadows and borders** for document separation
+ 
+ ## Classification System
+ 
+ ### Security Levels
+ 
+ - **Top Secret**: Red background with white text
+ - **Secret**: Orange background with white text  
+ - **Confidential**: Yellow background with black text
+ - **Unclassified**: Green background with white text
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Classification badge implementation
+ const getClassificationStyles = (classification: ClassificationLevel) => {
+   const baseStyles = 'inline-block px-3 py-1 text-sm font-bold tracking-wider transform -rotate-3 border-2'
+   
+   switch (classification) {
+     case 'top-secret':
+       return `${baseStyles} bg-red-600 text-white border-red-800 shadow-red-900/30`
+     case 'secret':
+       return `${baseStyles} bg-orange-500 text-white border-orange-700 shadow-orange-800/30`
+     case 'confidential':
+       return `${baseStyles} bg-yellow-500 text-black border-yellow-700 shadow-yellow-800/30`
+     case 'unclassified':
+       return `${baseStyles} bg-green-600 text-white border-green-800 shadow-green-900/30`
+   }
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Paper Texture System
+ 
+ ### Background Classes
+ 
+ - **document-background-manilla-light**: Light manilla paper
+ - **document-background-manilla-darker**: Darker manilla paper
+ - **document-background-manilla**: Standard manilla paper
+ - **subtle-graph-paper-grid-bg**: Graph paper texture
+ 
+ ### Texture Implementation
+ 
+ ```css
+ /* ✅ DO: Paper texture patterns */
+ .document-background-manilla-darker {
+   background-color: #f2f1e8;
+ }
+ 
+ .subtle-graph-paper-grid-bg {
+   background-color: #ffffff;
+   background-image: 
+     radial-gradient(circle, transparent 1px, #f3f4f6 1px),
+     repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 2px, #f3f4f6 2px, #f3f4f6 4px);
+   background-size: 8px 8px, 32px 32px, 32px 32px;
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Component Styling Patterns
+ 
+ ### Base Document Card
+ 
+ - **Paper-like appearance** with subtle shadows
+ - **Aged spots and vignettes** for authenticity
+ - **Masking tape effects** for attachment simulation
+ - **Hover animations** for interactivity
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Base document card styling
+ const VintageDocumentCard = ({className, children, classification, title, date, location}) => {
+   return (
+     <div className={cn(
+       'document-background-manilla-darker',
+       'subtle-graph-paper-grid-bg',
+       'shadow-2xl',
+       'rounded-lg p-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto',
+       'transform hover:scale-[1.01] transition-transform duration-300',
+       className
+     )}>
+       {/* Classification Badge */}
+       <ClassificationBadge level={classification} />
+       
+       {/* Masking tape effects */}
+       <div className='absolute top-2 left-8 w-16 h-8 bg-gray-200/80 transform -rotate-12 shadow-sm'>
+         <div className='absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-white/20 to-transparent'></div>
+       </div>
+       
+       {/* Document content */}
+       {children}
+       
+       {/* Vintage aging spots */}
+       <div className='absolute top-16 right-20 w-3 h-3 bg-amber-300/40 rounded-full blur-sm'></div>
+     </div>
+   )
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Typography System
+ 
+ - **Monospace fonts** for technical documents
+ - **Serif fonts** for formal documents
+ - **Consistent letter spacing** for vintage feel
+ - **Proper text hierarchy** with semantic HTML
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Typography patterns
+ const DocumentHeader = ({title, date, location}) => (
+   <div className='text-center mb-4'>
+     <h1 className='text-2xl font-bold text-black tracking-wider'>
+       {title}
+     </h1>
+     {date && (
+       <p className='text-lg text-gray-800 mt-1'>
+         &mdash; {date} &mdash;
+       </p>
+     )}
+     {location && (
+       <p className='text-sm text-gray-700 mt-1 italic'>{location}</p>
+     )}
+   </div>
+ )
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Interactive Elements
+ 
+ ### Hover Effects
+ 
+ - **Subtle scale transforms** on document cards
+ - **Smooth transitions** for all interactive elements
+ - **Consistent animation timing** across components
+ - **Accessible focus states** for keyboard navigation
+ 
+ ### Loading States
+ 
+ - **Skeleton loaders** with vintage styling
+ - **Progressive disclosure** of document content
+ - **Smooth fade-in animations** for content
+ - **Loading indicators** that match design system
+ 
+ ## Responsive Design
+ 
+ ### Breakpoint Strategy
+ 
+ - **Mobile-first approach** with vintage aesthetics
+ - **Flexible grid systems** for document layouts
+ - **Responsive typography** that maintains readability
+ - **Touch-friendly interactions** for mobile devices
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Responsive document layout
+ const DocumentLayout = ({children}) => (
+   <div className='grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6'>
+     {/* Photo/Image Section */}
+     <div className='md:col-span-1'>
+       {children.photo}
+     </div>
+     
+     {/* Content Section */}
+     <div className='md:col-span-2 space-y-4'>
+       {children.content}
+     </div>
+   </div>
+ )
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Mobile Optimizations
+ 
+ - **Simplified layouts** for small screens
+ - **Touch-friendly button sizes** (minimum 44px)
+ - **Readable text sizes** on all devices
+ - **Optimized image loading** for performance
+ 
+ ## Accessibility Standards
+ 
+ ### Color Contrast
+ 
+ - **WCAG AA compliance** for all text combinations
+ - **High contrast mode** support
+ - **Color-blind friendly** classification system
+ - **Semantic color usage** beyond aesthetics
+ 
+ ### Screen Reader Support
+ 
+ - **Proper heading hierarchy** in documents
+ - **Descriptive alt text** for images and diagrams
+ - **ARIA labels** for interactive elements
+ - **Skip links** for document navigation
+ 
+ ### Keyboard Navigation
+ 
+ - **Full keyboard accessibility** for all components
+ - **Visible focus indicators** that match design
+ - **Logical tab order** through document content
+ - **Escape key handling** for modals and overlays
+ 
+ ## Animation Guidelines
+ 
+ ### Micro-interactions
+ 
+ - **Subtle hover effects** that enhance UX
+ - **Smooth transitions** between states
+ - **Consistent timing** (300ms for most interactions)
+ - **Reduced motion support** for accessibility
+ 
+ ### Page Transitions
+ 
+ - **Fade-in animations** for document loading
+ - **Staggered content reveals** for complex documents
+ - **Smooth scrolling** to document sections
+ - **Loading states** that match vintage aesthetic
+ 
+ ## Component Variants
+ 
+ ### Document Types
+ 
+ - **Personnel Files**: Photo + information layout
+ - **Incident Reports**: Timeline + witness statements
+ - **Case Files**: Folder structure with multiple documents
+ - **Technical Documents**: Diagrams + specifications
+ 
+ ### Layout Patterns
+ 
+ - **Single Column**: Simple documents with minimal content
+ - **Two Column**: Photo + information split
+ - **Grid Layout**: Multiple sections with equal importance
+ - **Timeline Layout**: Chronological information display
+ 
+ ## Design Tokens
+ 
+ ### Colors
+ 
+ ```css
+ /* Document Backgrounds */
+ --document-manilla-light: #fcfcf5;
+ --document-manilla-darker: #f2f1e8;
+ --document-manilla: #d1bfa6;
+ 
+ /* Classification Colors */
+ --top-secret-bg: #dc2626;
+ --secret-bg: #f97316;
+ --confidential-bg: #eab308;
+ --unclassified-bg: #16a34a;
+ 
+ /* Text Colors */
+ --document-text-primary: #000000;
+ --document-text-secondary: #374151;
+ --document-text-muted: #6b7280;
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Spacing
+ 
+ ```css
+ /* Document Spacing */
+ --document-padding: 1.5rem;
+ --document-margin: 1rem;
+ --document-gap: 1.5rem;
+ --document-border-radius: 0.5rem;
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Typography
+ 
+ ```css
+ /* Font Families */
+ --font-vintage-mono: "Monument Grotesk Mono", monospace;
+ --font-vintage-serif: "Sentient", serif;
+ --font-vintage-sans: "Monument Grotesk", sans-serif;
+ 
+ /* Font Sizes */
+ --text-document-title: 1.5rem;
+ --text-document-subtitle: 1.125rem;
+ --text-document-body: 0.875rem;
+ --text-document-caption: 0.75rem;
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Best Practices
+ 
+ ### ✅ DO
+ 
+ - Use consistent paper textures across all documents
+ - Implement proper classification badges
+ - Maintain vintage aesthetics while ensuring accessibility
+ - Use semantic HTML for document structure
+ - Test with screen readers and keyboard navigation
+ - Optimize images for vintage appearance
+ - Implement responsive design for all screen sizes
+ - Use proper TypeScript types for document data
+ 
+ ### ❌ DON'T
+ 
+ - Sacrifice accessibility for vintage aesthetics
+ - Use low contrast text combinations
+ - Skip keyboard navigation implementation
+ - Ignore mobile user experience
+ - Use inconsistent spacing or typography
+ - Forget to test with assistive technologies
+ - Overuse vintage effects to the point of distraction
+ - Skip proper error states for document loading
+ 
+ ## Implementation Examples
+ 
+ ### Personnel File Card
+ 
+ ```typescript
+ // ✅ DO: Complete personnel file implementation
+ const PersonnelFileCard = ({personnel, className}) => {
+   return (
+     <VintageDocumentCard
+       classification={personnel.classification}
+       title={personnel.name}
+       date={personnel.date}
+       location={personnel.location}
+       className={cn('font-mono', className)}>
+
